credits.title: Frank & Louis
credits.overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

credits.title: Daggers Inn
credits.overview: When an enigmatic young woman arrives in a remote English village the locals are both intrigued and wary, their suspicions growing as she begins delving into their darkest secrets.

credits.title: Firebrand
credits.overview: Katherine Parr, the sixth wife of King Henry VIII, is named regent while the tyrant battles abroad. When the king returns, increasingly ill and paranoid, Katherine finds herself fighting for her own survival.

credits.title: Best Geezer
credits.overview: Three hapless entrepreneurs join forces to make a geezer movie.

credits.title: War of the Worlds: The Attack
credits.overview: Three young astronomers fight to survive a deadly Martian invasion.

credits.title: Repeat
credits.overview: A zealous cognitive psychologist stumbles across an unbelievable discovery – a way of communicating with the other side. His joy is short-lived, however, as his daughter is put into potentially grave danger and when all leads go cold, he takes matters into his own hands to find out the truth.

credits.title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Origins
credits.overview: Soldier Tony Tucker returns from the Falklands War; a bitter and angry man, he soon makes a name for himself in the Essex underworld with his security business and drug dealing, after entering a partnership with gangster Bernard O'Mahoney, his life spirals out of control in a cycle of drugs and violence. credits.title: The Pebble and the Boy
credits.overview: John Parker, a 19 year old from Manchester, embarks on a journey to Brighton, the spiritual home of the Mods, on an old Lambretta scooter left to him by his father.
